thesis: Civic responsibility is reciprocal and cannot be reduced to obedience or unlimited vigilance.

ideas.statement: Power must answer to citizens as citizens answer for participation; a system demanding heroism for ordinary truthfulness is institutionally defective.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Disobedience needs justification, risk does not absolve every harmful collaboration, and benefit can ground prospective contribution without proving personal guilt.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Disobedience needs justification, risk does not absolve every harmful collaboration, and benefit can ground prospective contribution without proving personal guilt.

audit.notes: All batch units analyzed directly; practical cases and normative limits preserved.
